messages.content: 你可以告訴我2020-12-25和2021-01-01在紐約市的天氣如何，並且提供2021-01-15在地理坐標（40.7128，-74.0060）的歷史天氣數據嗎？此外，你能預測接下來10天在相同坐標的天氣嗎？

function.name: weather_get_forecast_by_coordinates
function.description: Get the weather forecast for a specific geographical coordinates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

coordinates.description: The geographical coordinates for which to retrieve the weather. The first element of the tuple is the latitude and the second is the longitude.

days_ahead.description: Number of days to forecast from current date (optional, default is 7).

function.name: weather_get_by_coordinates_date
function.description: Retrieves the historical weather data based on coordinates and date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

coordinates.description: The geographical coordinates for which to retrieve the weather. The first element of the tuple is the latitude and the second is the longitude.

date.description: The date for which to retrieve the historical weather data in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

function.name: weather_get_by_city_date
function.description: Retrieves the historical weather data based on city and date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The city for which to retrieve the weather.

date.description: The date for which to retrieve the historical weather data in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
